experiment.title: Do boom–bust cycles appear?
experiment.hypothesis: With logistic resource regrowth, the forager population overshoots what the resource can sustain and then crashes, producing repeated boom–bust oscillations rather than settling at a steady size.

model.name: Autonomous-agent ecosystem
model.description: Foragers with heritable speed and sensing compete for a regrowing resource on a toroidal grid.
